## PROCESS DEFECTS HIT WHILE EXECUTING

- tools/git-commit-mine CANNOT COMMIT A RENAME. It stages with `git add -f -- <path>`, and `-f` makes pathspec matching worktree-only, so a deleted-in-worktree tracked file fails with "pathspec did not match any files" and the wrapper refuses the whole commit. `git add -A -- <path>` handles it. Every commit in this row therefore staged its exact path list manually, verified `git diff --cached --name-only` equalled the intended list byte-for-byte, and committed through the hook's sanctioned GIT_MINE_EXPLICIT=1 channel (T455) — the same channel `--explicit` uses. Worth a defect row: the wrapper's four guarantees are all reproducible, but a tool that cannot express a rename pushes every rename outside it.
- The bundle's declared scope is `deliverables=` only (two findings files), so both the wrapper and the pre-commit hook refuse every doc this refactor exists to edit, even though the row's own `holds=` in tasks.json names GLOSSARY.md, DIRECTION.md, WAYPOINTS.md, LANDMARKS.md and both ROADMAPs. Scope should union `holds=` with `deliverables=`; until it does, every doc-refactor row must go through --explicit for entirely uninteresting reasons.
- src/managent/main.zig:6217 carries a stale PHASES.md mention in a comment. T760 (deepseek-v4-pro) holds the file, so T757 reverted its edit and sent directive D021f (re-keyed from the D021 it was minted as) asking T760 to fold the one-line comment repoint into its own commit.
